onboarding.error: Sign-in was cancelled or failed. Please try again.

partners.title: Saved partners
partners.empty: No saved partners yet. After a duet, save your partner to sing again in one tap.

voice.title: Live voice
voice.consentBody: Caraoke needs your microphone so you and your partner can hear each other while you sing. Your voice is live only — it is never recorded or stored.
voice.waitingPartner: Waiting for your partner to join…
voice.partnerConnected: Your partner is here — say hi!
voice.error: Couldn't open voice. Please try again.

ready.title: Ready to sing?
ready.intro: When you're both ready, Caraoke will start the song together.
ready.partnerReady: Your partner is ready — tap when you are.
ready.bothReady: You're both ready! Get ready to sing 🎤

join.title: Join a duet
join.intro: Enter the pairing code your partner shared, or open their invite link.
join.bothConnected: You and your partner are both connected.
join.waiting: Waiting for your partner to connect…
join.error: Couldn't join. Please check the code and try again.

session.title: Invite a partner
session.intro: Share this link or code with the person you want to sing with.
session.shareMessage: Sing with me on Caraoke! Open {{url}} or enter code {{code}}.
session.error: Couldn't create the session. Please try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your account and all your data. This cannot be undone.

spotify.title: Connect Spotify
spotify.intro: Caraoke plays the song from your own Spotify. A Premium account is required to sing together.
spotify.notPremiumBody: Your Spotify account is "{{product}}". Caraoke duets need Spotify Premium.
spotify.error: Couldn't connect Spotify. Please try again.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language for the app and your Caraoke voice.

discovery.title: Discover nearby singers
discovery.description: Let other Caraoke singers in your area find you for a spontaneous duet. Off by default — your choice.
discovery.toggleSublabel: Off by default — opt in to be found.
discovery.enabledNote: You'll appear to nearby Caraoke singers while this is on.
discovery.riffRationale: You'll now appear to nearby Caraoke singers. Turn this off anytime in settings.
discovery.underageBody: Discovery connects you with nearby singers. It's available to verified users 18 and over.
discovery.underageRiff: Discovery is for adult singers — 18 and over. This feature won't be available.
discovery.failedBody: We weren't able to verify your age. Please try again.
